flagged.evidence: The proof defines s_J using only modes with |m|≤J, then asserts that the averaging operator isolates the n-th Fourier term. Take f=f_3, n=3, J=0, L=4: L>J+|n|, but s_0=0, so Q_{3,4}s_0=0 while the claimed term is f_3≠0. Restricting to J≥|n| closes this gap; the limit argument is unaffected.
